run_ml_train_co2r: run the ml_train CLI to train linear and RF models on CO2R experimental data with cross-validation
run_ml_train_her: run the ml_train CLI to train ML models predicting HER voltage using leave-one-composition-out cross-validation
run_ml_train_with_processed_df: run the ml_train CLI with a preprocessed CSV dataframe to skip raw data loading and preprocessing
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run the ml_train CLI with matminer elemental features enabled for improved model predictions
run_ml_train_xrd_matched: run the ml_train CLI filtering on XRD matched samples only for higher quality experimental data
